DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の担当区画へ入る前に、表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the signs before entering your assigned area today.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨で線が薄くなって、担当の境目がわかりません。どこまで入ってよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨で線が薄くなり担当区画の立入範囲を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: The rain has faded the lines, and I can't tell where my assigned area ends. I'd like to check how far I'm allowed to enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that rain has faded the lines and you want to confirm where you may enter in your assigned area. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見えない境界を推測せず、今いる安全な確認場所で待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't guess at boundaries you can't see. Please wait at the safe checking point where you are now.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 線の先へ進んでいません。今の図と朝に見た図は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 境界を越えていないと報告し朝と現在の図が同じか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't gone beyond the line. Is the current diagram the same as the one I saw this morning?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that you have not crossed the boundary and ask whether the current diagram is the same as this morning's. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更があるか責任者に確認します。朝の記憶だけで判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the supervisor whether there have been changes. Don't judge just from your memory of this morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 境界がわかる新しい表示が出るまで、道具も運び込まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 境界の新表示が出るまで道具も持ち込まないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll make sure not to bring tools in either until new markings make the boundary clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not bring tools in until the new boundary markings are in place. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 道具の搬入経路も併せて確認しましょう。担当と通路は別に示されることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's also check the route for bringing tools in. Work assignments and passageways may be marked separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 作業する場所だけでなく、通ってよい道も説明してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業区画に加えて通行可能な道も説明してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like an explanation of the routes I'm allowed to use as well as where to work.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of permitted routes in addition to the work area. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に図で説明します。区画名と経路を復唱してから進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, I'll explain on the diagram. Please repeat the area name and route back before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を復唱し、現地表示と一致しなければ責任者へ伝えて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明を復唱し現地表示と違えば責任者に報告して待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll repeat the explanation back, and if it doesn't match the signs on site, I'll tell the supervisor and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will repeat the explanation and report to the supervisor and wait if it differs from the on-site signs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の待機を続けてください。責任者へ確認して戻りますので、いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep waiting here. I'll check with the supervisor and return, so excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちのカードについて何かございましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened regarding your card?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カードが見当たりません。最後に機械で使ったあと、持ち帰ったか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 最後に機械で使用したカードを持ち帰ったか覚えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find my card. After I last used it at a machine, I don't remember whether I took it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not remember whether you brought home the card you last used at a machine. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用を止める相談として担当者へおつなぎします。いつ頃、どこで使ったかはわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll connect you with the staff member to discuss blocking its use. Do you know roughly when and where you used it?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方です。機械の場所の写真はありますが、カード番号はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夕方で場所の写真はあるが番号は不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday evening. I have a photo of where the machine is, but I don't know the card number.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it was yesterday evening and you have a photo of the location but do not know the number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかる情報を担当者へお伝えください。他のカードと取り違えていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the staff member what you do know. Have you possibly confused it with another card?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 財布には別のカードがありました。なくしたのは、この銀行のカードだと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 財布の別カードを確認し紛失はこの銀行のカードと思うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: There was a different card in my wallet. I think the one I lost is this bank's card.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you checked the other card in your wallet and think the lost card belongs to this bank. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手続きの前に、確認できる情報を整理しましょう。写真の提示は相談席でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's organize the information we can verify before the procedure. Please show the photo at the consultation seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相談席で見せます。停止をお願いした場合の確認結果も、書いて残せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真は相談席で示し停止の確認結果を書面等に残せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show it at the consultation seat. Can the result of the check when I request a block also be kept in writing?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will show the photo at the consultation seat and ask whether the blocking confirmation result can be recorded in writing or another form. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どのように記録をお渡しできるか担当者へ確認します。停止の完了は案内を受けてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the staff member how a record can be provided. Please confirm that blocking is complete when you receive the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手続きが済んだと思い込まず、確認結果と次の連絡方法を聞いてメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止済みと思い込まず結果と次の連絡方法を確認して記録すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume the procedure is finished. I'll ask for the confirmation result and the next way to contact you, and make a note.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume the card is already blocked and will confirm and record the result and next contact method. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望を担当者へ伝えます。写真を準備して相談席でお待ちください。私は担当者を呼んでまいります。確認が済むまで、ひとまず失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that request to the staff member. Please have the photo ready and wait at the consultation seat. I'll go and call the staff member. Excuse me for now while we complete the checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お母様はこちらの椅子で休まれますか。改札までご案内できますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would your mother like to rest in this chair? I can guide you to the ticket gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母は杖を使っています。私がこのスーツケースを運ぶので、階段のない道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母が杖を使い自分が荷物を運ぶため階段を避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother uses a walking stick. I'll carry this suitcase, so please show us a route without stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother uses a walking stick and you will carry the luggage, so you want to avoid stairs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この構内図では、右の通路を進むとエレベーターに着きます。どの列車をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this station map, the passage on the right leads to the elevator. Which train will you take?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十四時の鳥栖方面の列車です。先に改札を通る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十四時の鳥栖方面の列車に乗る前に改札を通るか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The two o'clock train toward Tosu. Do we need to go through the ticket gates first?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether to pass through the ticket gates before boarding the two o'clock train toward Tosu. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この図の青い線で改札を通り、その先のエレベーターでホームへ上がります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Follow the blue line on this map through the gates, then take the elevator beyond them up to the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ホームに着くまで母が休める椅子はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ホームへ行く途中に母が座れる椅子を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Are there chairs where my mother can rest before we reach the platform?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Look for a chair where your mother can sit on the way to the platform. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改札の手前に椅子があります。そこからエレベーターまでは段差のない通路です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are chairs before the ticket gates. From there to the elevator, the passage has no steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中でエレベーターが使えなかったら、母をそこに座らせてこちらへ戻ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: エレベーター停止時に母を残して戻る必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the elevator is out of use along the way, may I have my mother sit there and come back here?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you would need to leave your mother and return if the elevator is out of service. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 無理に階段へ向かわず、近くの係員を呼んでください。お母様から離れずに済むよう対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't try to use the stairs; call a nearby staff member. We'll help so you don't have to leave your mother.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、まず改札前の椅子で休み、母と一緒に青い線の道を進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 改札前で休んでから母と青い線の経路を進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then we'll rest in the chairs before the gates first and follow the blue-line route together.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will rest before the gates, then follow the blue-line route with your mother. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順番で大丈夫です。どうぞ足元に気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That order is fine. Please watch your step. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。まず、今日はどんな症状で来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit, I understand. First, what symptoms have brought you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三日前から咳が続いています。予約はありますが、紹介状を家に置いてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三日前からの咳と予約があり紹介状を忘れたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've had a cough for three days. I have an appointment, but I left my referral letter at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have had a cough for three days, have an appointment, and forgot your referral letter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、息苦しさはありますか。紹介状の手続きは初診受付で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you short of breath now? We'll check the referral-letter procedure at first-visit reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 息苦しさはありません。熱は昨夜三十七度八分でした。お薬手帳も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 息苦しさはなく昨夜三十七度八分だったと答えお薬手帳の要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm not short of breath. My temperature was 37.8 degrees last night. Do you need my medication record book too?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you are not short of breath and had a temperature of 37.8 last night, and ask whether your medication record book is needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 服用中の薬を確認するため、お持ちでしたら見せてください。本人確認用の書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you have it, please show it so we can check what medicines you take. Do you have documents for identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードとマイナンバーカード、それからお薬手帳を持っています。紹介状だけ後から出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在留カードとマイナンバーカードとお薬手帳があり紹介状の後日提出を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my residence card, My Number card, and medication record book. Can I submit just the referral letter later?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a residence card, My Number card, and medication record book, and discuss submitting the referral letter later. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 後日提出できるか、受付担当に確認してもらいましょう。私から予約と症状を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's have the reception staff check whether you can submit it at a later date. I'll tell them about your appointment and symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付へ行く前に、咳があることを問診票に書いておいたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 咳の情報を受付へ行く前に記入するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before I go to reception, should I write on the medical questionnaire that I have a cough?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether to write down the cough information before going to reception. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、いつから続いているかと昨夜の体温を書いてください。途中で苦しくなったらすぐ声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please write when it started and your temperature last night. If you have trouble breathing along the way, tell us immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三日前からの咳と昨夜の体温を書いて、受付で紹介状の提出方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 症状と体温を書いて紹介状の提出方法を受付で聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write that I've had a cough for three days and last night's temperature, and ask reception how to submit the referral letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will write the symptoms and temperature and ask reception how to submit the referral letter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書けたら初診受付へご案内しますね。ここでの確認は以上です。お大事に、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you've written it, I'll guide you to first-visit reception. That's all for the checks here. Take care, and excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その棚の値札でしょうか。文字が小さいので、近くでご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you mean the price label on that shelf? The print is small, so I'll explain up close.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ヨーグルトを一つ買いたいのですが、二百円という値段はこの大きい容器のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一つ買いたい大きいヨーグルトが二百円の対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy one yogurt. Does the 200-yen price apply to this large container?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the large yogurt you want to buy one of is the item priced at 200 yen. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その表示は、小さい容器を二個買った場合の合計です。大きい容器は隣の値札です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That label shows the total for two small containers. The price for the large container is on the next label.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さいほうを一個だけ買うと、いくらになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さい容器一個の価格を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: How much is it if I buy just one small container?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the price of one small container. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この棚の表示では一個百十円です。二個で二百円になる組合せには条件があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The label on this shelf says 110 yen each. There are conditions for the combination that costs 200 yen for two.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 違う味を一個ずつ選んでも、その組合せになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 違う味を一個ずつ買って割引対象になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Would choosing one each of different flavors qualify for that combination?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether buying one each of different flavors qualifies for the discount. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じシリーズなら対象ですが、低糖タイプは別シリーズです。ここに並ぶプレーンといちご味なら対象です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: They qualify if they're from the same series, but the low-sugar type is a separate series. The plain and strawberry ones here qualify.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食べ切れるか迷っています。賞味期限は両方とも同じ日ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二個を食べ切れるか迷い賞味期限の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm not sure I can finish them. Do both have the same best-before date?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are unsure you can finish two and ask about the difference in best-before dates. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 片方は十七日、もう片方は十九日です。一個だけでもお買い求めいただけますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: One is dated the seventeenth and the other the nineteenth. You're welcome to buy just one.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は十九日までの一個にします。百十円のほうでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十九日までの一個を百十円で購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll take one that's good until the nineteenth. The 110-yen option, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will buy one with a best-before date of the nineteenth for 110 yen. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。選ばなかった分はこちらへ戻します。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll put back the one you didn't choose. Thank you, and please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お弁当は温めますか。お飲み物も一緒にお持ち帰りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like your boxed meal heated? You're taking the drink away too, right?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 弁当は温めてください。飲み物はこの布袋に入れるので、弁当用の袋だけ欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 温める弁当だけ袋を頼み飲み物は布袋へ入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please heat the meal. I'll put the drink in this cloth bag, so I only want a bag for the meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a bag only for the heated meal and say the drink will go in your cloth bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用店舗では小さい袋が三円です。お弁当が傾かないサイズでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this learning-purpose shop, a small bag costs three yen. Is a size that keeps the meal from tilting all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。箸も一本ください。支払いは交通系のカードでできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箸一本を頼み交通系カードの利用可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Please give me one pair of chopsticks too. Can I pay with a transit card?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request one pair of chopsticks and ask whether a transit card can be used. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この端末では使えます。袋代を含めて七百十三円です。読み取り部分へかざしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use it on this terminal. The total, including the bag, is 713 yen. Please hold it over the reader.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残高が六百円しかありません。足りない分だけ現金で払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード残高六百円で不足分を現金にできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My balance is only 600 yen. Can I pay just the difference in cash?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the card balance is 600 yen and ask whether you can pay the shortfall in cash. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この店舗の端末では分割できません。全額現金か、チャージ後のカード払いになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: This shop's terminal can't split payment. You can pay the full amount in cash or use the card after topping it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら全額現金にします。千円札で払って、レシートもください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 千円札で全額払いレシートを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll pay it all in cash. I'll use a 1,000-yen note, and please give me a receipt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pay the full amount with a 1,000-yen note and request a receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お釣りは二百八十七円です。レシートはこちらです。お弁当の袋と飲み物は分けて置きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your change is 287 yen. Here's your receipt. I'll set the bagged meal and drink down separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。飲み物は自分の袋に入れて、弁当は水平に持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲み物を自分の袋に入れ弁当を水平に持つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received them. I'll put the drink in my own bag and keep the meal level on my way home.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will put the drink in your own bag and carry the meal level. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 温かいので袋の持ち手をお持ちください。ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's hot, so please hold the bag by its handles. Thank you. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知を拝見してもよろしいですか。差出人が分かるところを見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I see the notice you've brought? Please show me where the sender is identified.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 封筒は捨ててしまいました。この紙に追加書類とありますが、何を出すのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒を捨て追加書類の内容が分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I threw away the envelope. This paper says additional documents, but I don't know what to submit.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you threw away the envelope and do not know what additional documents are required. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本文の上に担当課名がありますね。ご本人宛ての通知か、お名前も確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's a department name above the main text. Please also let me check your name to see whether the notice is addressed to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前は私です。十八日必着と書いてあります。窓口に持ってきても間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分宛てで十八日必着の通知を窓口へ持参できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is my name. It says it must arrive by the eighteenth. Would I still be in time if I brought it to the counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the notice is addressed to you and must arrive by the eighteenth, and ask about bringing it to the counter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出方法は担当課が確認します。案内窓口では受理を約束できませんが、今おつなぎできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible department will check the submission method. The information counter can't promise acceptance, but we can connect you now.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今日は書類がそろっていないので、必要なものをメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類がそろっていないため必要なものをメモしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I don't have all the documents today, so I'd like to note what's needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not have all the documents and want to note what is needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者につながりました。この番号札で相談できます。通知そのものと身分証もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've reached the staff member. You can consult them using this queue ticket. Please take the notice itself and your identification too.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元の通知も渡すのですか。内容を見直せるよう手元に残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知を手元に残したいので原本提出の要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Do I hand over the original notice too? I'd like to keep it so I can review the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the original notice must be submitted because you want to keep it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出が必要かは担当者に聞いてください。必要なら、相談前にご自分の控えを取っておくと安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the staff member whether submission is required. If it is, making your own copy before the consultation can give you peace of mind.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知の控えを取ってから、担当者に必要書類と窓口提出の期限を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えを取り必要書類と窓口提出期限を担当者に聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll make a copy of the notice, then ask the staff member what documents are needed and the deadline for counter submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will make a copy and ask the staff member about the required documents and counter-submission deadline. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当窓口はこの案内図の丸印です。ご相談はこちらで以上です。お気をつけて、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: The responsible counter is circled on this map. That's all for the consultation here. Take care, and excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱の中身を教えていただけますか。壊れやすいものは入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me what's in the box? Is there anything fragile?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 陶器の茶入れです。本体は包みましたが、ふたは上に載せたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 陶器の茶入れでふたを本体に載せたままだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a ceramic tea container. I've wrapped the body, but the lid is still resting on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say it is a ceramic tea container with the lid still resting on the body. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ふたが動くと当たって割れるおそれがあります。別々に包み、箱の中で動かないようにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: If the lid moves, it could hit the body and break. Can you wrap them separately and keep them from moving inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで包み直したいです。緩衝材は持っているので、台を使わせてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手持ちの緩衝材で包み直すため台の利用を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to wrap them again here. I have cushioning material, so may I use a worktable?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request use of a table to rewrap it with your own cushioning material. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この学習用窓口では、横の梱包台をお使いいただけます。差出先は国内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: At this learning-purpose counter, you can use the packing table beside us. Is the destination within Japan?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大阪の友人に送ります。明後日までに欲しいそうですが、今出せば届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大阪の友人へ明後日までに届けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm sending it to a friend in Osaka. They'd like it by the day after tomorrow. Will it arrive if I send it now?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want it delivered to a friend in Osaka by the day after tomorrow. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お届け日は宛先や受付時刻によります。郵便番号で確認できますが、遅延の可能性はあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The delivery date depends on the destination and acceptance time. We can check using the postal code, but delays are possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確約できないことは友人に伝えます。追跡番号で配達状況を見られる方法を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着保証がないことを了承し追跡番号のある方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my friend that you can't guarantee it. I'd like to choose a service where I can check delivery status with a tracking number.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that arrival is not guaranteed and choose a method with a tracking number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、梱包後に大きさと重さを測り、追跡できる方法の料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then, after packing, we'll measure its size and weight and explain the charges for trackable services.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まずふたと本体を別に包み、隙間を埋めます。宛先を書いたら計量をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本体とふたを別に包み隙間を埋めて計量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I'll wrap the lid and body separately and fill the gaps. Once I've written the address, please weigh it.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wrap the body and lid separately, fill the gaps, and request weighing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 梱包台へどうぞ。準備ができたらお声がけください。いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the packing table. Let us know when you're ready. Excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込画面で止まっているところがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there somewhere you're stuck on the transfer screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書ではサガ設備ですが、画面にはサガ設備工業と出ました。このまま振り込んでいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求書のサガ設備と画面のサガ設備工業が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The invoice says Saga Setsubi, but the screen shows Saga Setsubi Kogyo. Is it all right to transfer the money as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that Saga Setsubi on the invoice differs from Saga Setsubi Kogyo on the screen. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名義が違う場合は、いったん進めないでください。支店名と口座番号は請求書と一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: If the account name differs, don't proceed for now. Do the branch name and account number match the invoice?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号は一致しています。ただ、振込先の変更を知らせるメールが昨日届いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口座番号は一致するが前日に変更メールが届いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number matches. However, I received an email yesterday announcing a change of transfer destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the account number matches but an email announcing a change arrived the previous day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更の真偽をこちらでは確認できません。いつも使っている連絡先で請求元へ確認するのがよいと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't verify whether the change is genuine here. I think you should check with the invoicing party using your usual contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メールに書かれた番号ではなく、以前の請求書の電話番号にかけます。今日は振込を取り消せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前の電話番号で確認するため今日の操作を取り消せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll call the number on an older invoice, rather than the number in the email. Can I cancel today's operation?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can cancel today's operation so you can check using the previous phone number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ最終確認前なので、この操作は中止できます。送金してからの取消しとは扱いが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You're still before the final confirmation, so you can stop this operation. It's treated differently from canceling after money has been sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。名義を確認してからやり直します。手数料はどの段階で表示されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名義確認後にやり直す際の手数料表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I'll check the account name and start again. At what stage is the fee shown?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask when the fee will be displayed when you start again after checking the account name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 金額と振込先を入力した後の確認画面で表示されます。合計を見てから実行してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It appears on the confirmation screen after entering the amount and destination. Check the total before executing the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の操作は中止し、以前からの番号で相手に確認します。再入力したら手数料も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 操作を中止し既存の連絡先で確認後に再入力すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll stop this operation and check with them using the number I've used before. When I enter it again, I'll check the fee too.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will stop the operation, check through an existing contact method, and then enter the details again. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 中止されたことを一緒に確認しました。ご来店ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've checked together that it was stopped. Thank you for visiting. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学のお時間についてのご相談ですね。何名でお越しになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a time to visit, right? How many people are planning to come?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父と二人です。父は説明をゆっくり聞きたいので、団体と重ならない時間を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父と二人でゆっくり説明を聞ける団体と重ならない時間を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father and I. He'd like to listen to the explanations at a leisurely pace, so we're looking for a time that doesn't overlap with groups.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you and your father want a time without groups so you can listen to the explanations at a leisurely pace. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習場面の予約表では、午前中に団体が二組あります。午後なら比較的静かな時間があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The reservation schedule in this learning scenario has two groups in the morning. There are relatively quiet times in the afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後二時なら来られます。解説を聞くには、先に予約が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 午後二時の解説利用に事前予約が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We can come at two in the afternoon. Do we need to book in advance to hear an explanation?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether an advance reservation is needed for an explanation at two in the afternoon. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個別解説の空きは担当者が調整します。常設展示を自由に見るだけなら、この場面では予約不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will arrange availability for an individual explanation. In this scenario, you don't need a reservation just to view the permanent exhibits on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 個別解説がなければ、父と展示の説明を読んで回ります。休める場所もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 個別解説がない場合に説明を読みながら回り休める場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If an individual explanation isn't available, I'll read the exhibit descriptions as I go around with my father. Is there also somewhere to rest?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that without an individual explanation you will read the descriptions while looking around, and ask about a resting place. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 館内図に休憩場所を載せています。展示を途中まで見て、そこで休む経路も選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The floor map shows resting places. You can also choose a route where you see part of the exhibits and rest there.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予定を変えるかもしれません。来る前に団体の状況を確認するなら、どこへ連絡しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来訪前に団体状況を確認する連絡先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Our plans might change. If I want to check the group situation before coming, who should I contact?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whom to contact to check the group situation before visiting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内用の連絡カードにある代表窓口へ、見学予定日と午後二時とお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Contact the main desk shown on this information contact card, and tell them your planned visit date and two in the afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: カードを持ち帰ります。来る前に混み具合を聞いて、父の体調を見て見学を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡カードを持帰り混み具合と父の体調で予定を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the card home. Before coming, I'll ask how busy it is and decide about the visit based on my father's health.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the contact card home and decide your plans based on crowding and your father's health. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理のない予定でお越しください。お問い合わせありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come with a schedule that doesn't overtax you. Thank you for your inquiry. Goodbye.
